title: Italian Tomato, Mozzarella and Basil Salad
summary: A simple Caprese-style salad with juicy tomatoes, creamy mozzarella, fresh basil and a sweet-sharp balsamic dressing. It is perfect for a light vegetarian lunch or as part of a summer spread.
steps: Arrange the sliced tomatoes and mozzarella on a large plate, overlapping them slightly for an even layer.
Tuck the basil leaves between the tomato and mozzarella slices so the herbs are spread throughout the salad.
Drizzle over the olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Sprinkle with salt and black pepper, then let the salad sit for 5 minutes so the tomatoes release a little juice and the flavours mingle.
Serve immediately while the tomatoes are fresh and the mozzarella is soft and creamy.
